mechanism: Both agents can elevate uric acid levels and cause hyperuricemia; gemfibrozil may displace pyrazinamide from protein binding, and both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism with potential for additive hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels, liver function tests, and gout symptoms; consider alternative antituberculosis agents if hyperuricemia develops; assess hepatic function baseline and periodically during concurrent use.
